subject: Mythology
title: Afrofuturism: Ancient Myths Meet the Future
description: A 60-second lesson on Afrofuturism: Ancient Myths Meet the Future.

hook.text: Afrofuturism reimagines African mythology through sci-fi, asking what Africa looks like when rooted in its past.

buildup.text: Black Panther's Wakanda draws on real African mythologies: ancestor worship, spirit realms, and divine kingship.

discovery.text: Artists, musicians, and writers use Orishas, Dogon cosmology, and Zulu traditions to build futuristic African worlds.

twist.text: Afrofuturism challenges the idea that technology and African tradition are opposites. They are deeply compatible.

climax.text: Black Panther earned $1.3 billion worldwide, proving global audiences are hungry for African mythological storytelling.

punchline.text: Africa's oldest stories became the blueprint for its imagined future.

quiz.question: What African mythological elements appear in Wakanda from Black Panther?
options: Ancestor worship, spirit realms, and divine kingship from real African traditions
Egyptian pyramid symbolism and hieroglyphic writing
